# obsidian-compat resolution GT — provenance

**This pack is DATA, generated by the live Obsidian resolver — never hand-written,
never hand-patched.** Hand-frozen resolution fixtures are dead (gate-1 ruling 7;
decision 013; contract §4.5, §13.4). It is the `obsidian-compat@<app-version>`
regression fixture set that pins the app's actual walk against version drift.

## Generation

```
./generate.sh          # re-probes the live app, rewrites resolution.expected.json
```

- **Oracle:** live Obsidian desktop app, resolver called through the
  `probe-bridge` plugin (`window.__ob === require("obsidian")`), which exposes
  `parseLinktext` and `resolveSubpath`; stage 1 `getFirstLinkpathDest` and the
  metadata cache are on `app` directly.
- **Command (verbatim):** `obsidian eval code="$(cat oracle.js)"`, driven by
  `generate.sh` (which stamps the app version + timestamp + corpus checksums).
- **App version (this pack):** `1.12.7` (from
  `/Applications/Obsidian.app/Contents/Info.plist` `CFBundleShortVersionString`).
- **Generated:** `2026-07-19T02:11:24Z`.
- **Zero hand-written answers:** every `answer` in `resolution.expected.json`
  is the resolver's own output (heading/block span, or `ref_not_found` + stage),
  captured by the script. Editing an answer by hand voids the pack.

## Files

| File | Role |
|---|---|
| `oracle.js` | the resolver harness (fixed probe set; run via `obsidian eval`) |
| `generate.sh` | one-command regeneration (enables bridge, runs oracle, assembles JSON) |
| `walkvault/walk.md`, `walkvault/blocks.md` | corpus, byte-identical to the gate-3 adversarial-harness `walkvault/`; the vault the probes resolve against |
| `resolution.expected.json` | the generated pack: metadata + probe answers |

Corpus integrity is pinned by `corpus_sha256` inside `resolution.expected.json`;
the answers correspond to exactly those bytes.

## Probe set (FIXED — gate-1 ruling 4 + decision 013)

ZT's **six walk-law probes** (WL-6 is the `#A#a/b` vs `#A#a#b` hpath-join
divergence pair, realized as entries WL-6a/WL-6b) plus the **`_`-bearing anchor
probe** (WX-6). All `from: walk.md`; refs are raw linktext (wire form).

| id | ref | walk law | live-app answer (1.12.7) |
|---|---|---|---|
| WL-1 | `#B#Beta` | anywhere-after (closed B/C/A never stop the walk) | `walk.md` span `[183,204]` — A's first `## Beta` |
| WL-2 | `#B#b` | generation-skipping (level 1→3, X unnamed) | `walk.md` span `[31,102]` — `### b` under B›X |
| WL-3 | `#B#C` | strictly-deeper-level (C is level 1, = B) | `ref_not_found` stage 2 |
| WL-4 | `#A#Beta` | first-match-wins on duplicates, **silent** | `walk.md` span `[183,204]` — first `## Beta` |
| WL-5 | `#b#beta` | case-insensitive, both segments | `walk.md` span `[183,204]` |
| WL-6a | `#A#a/b` | `/` is not a path join — one literal-heading segment | `walk.md` span `[329,393]` (EOF) — `## a/b` |
| WL-6b | `#A#a#b` | one more `#` → a different node; the pair must diverge | `walk.md` span `[282,329]` — `### b` under `## a` |
| WX-6 | `blocks#^under-probe_x` | decision-011 `_` probe: what the app DOES with a legacy `_` id | `ref_not_found` stage 2 |

**WX-6 finding (the point of the `_` probe):** the app **silently drops** the
`_`-bearing block id — `blocks.md`'s registered block cache is `{dup1, clean-1}`
only; `under-probe_x` never enters it (Obsidian's block-id charset excludes `_`).
So the app resolves nothing for it (stage-2 miss). This is conforming, not a pack
failure: our engine refusing `_` anchors out-of-grammar (loud `bad_request`)
matches the reality that the app has nothing to reproduce (decision 013,
consequence 3). The pack pins the app's actual treatment against future drift.

## Version-drift posture (contract §13.3–§13.4)

- **§13.4:** app version drift is a **pack-pinned unknown, never asserted** —
  answers are frozen as `obsidian-compat@1.12.7` at default settings, and
  **re-generated per app version via the live oracle**. Hand-frozen resolution
  fixtures are dead.
- **§13.3:** on the app bump (or any major resolver-affecting dependency bump),
  the pack is **re-probed, never assumed to carry**. Procedure: bump Obsidian →
  run `./generate.sh` → the new `app_version` stamp + git diff make the drift
  reviewable. A stale `app_version` vs the installed app is itself a finding.
